summary: This guide showcases an updated Aura team composition targeting the Level 200 Fire Guardians in Season 9 Crown Contest Round 2. The critical strategy centers around reaching Resistance thresholds to counter the bosses' 270 Accuracy and avoid Recharging Speed Penalties. Leveraging Ardreth's Stand United talent allows adjacent heroes to meet Resistance needs easily while Talethia serves as the primary damage carry. The new hero Holfast boosts overall output to 3.67 billion damage, though Lincos remains a viable alternative achieving 2.02 billion.

meta_changes: The addition of Holfast significantly elevates the Aura team's damage ceiling in Crown Contest compared to running Lincos.
tips: Level 200 Fire Guardians have 270 Accuracy; ensure all heroes have enough Resistance to avoid the Recharging Speed Penalty.
Position adjacent allies next to a high-Resistance Ardreth to leverage her Stand United talent (shares 20% Resistance), reducing personal gear Resistance requirements on other heroes to ~150.
Build Diantha with at least 240+ Accuracy and Witch's Remains to consistently apply Defense Penalty II.
